sources.title: The Quranic Arabic Corpus, version 0.4 (Kais Dukes, University of Leeds)

resources.name: association-pairs
resources.title: Divine Discourses: association-pairs
resources.description: Root-pair association statistics: the union of every pair appearing in any root's top-25-by-LLR partner list, deduplicated by unordered pair.

fields.name: rootA
fields.description: First root of the pair (Buckwalter).

fields.name: rootASafeKey
fields.description: URL/filename-safe encoding of rootA.

fields.name: rootALatin
fields.description: rootA in Latin transliteration.

fields.name: rootB
fields.description: Second root of the pair (Buckwalter).

fields.name: rootBSafeKey
fields.description: URL/filename-safe encoding of rootB.

fields.name: rootBLatin
fields.description: rootB in Latin transliteration.

fields.name: sharedVerses
fields.description: k11: number of verses in which both roots are attested. Unit: verses.

fields.name: pmi
fields.description: Pointwise mutual information: log2((k11*N)/((k11+k12)*(k11+k21))), N=6,236, rounded to 2 decimals. Unit: bits (log base 2).

fields.name: dice
fields.description: Dice coefficient: 2*k11/(2*k11+k12+k21), rounded to 3 decimals.

fields.name: llr
fields.description: Dunning's log-likelihood ratio (G2) over the pair's verse-level 2x2 table, rounded to 2 decimals.

resources.name: centrality
resources.title: Divine Discourses: centrality
resources.description: Network centrality for all 1,642 roots over the root co-occurrence graph (5,211 edges, built from each root's top-25-by-LLR partners).

fields.name: root
fields.description: Buckwalter-transliterated root.

fields.name: safeKey
fields.description: URL/filename-safe encoding of root.

fields.name: rootLatin
fields.description: Root in Latin transliteration with diacritics.

fields.name: degree
fields.description: Count of distinct partner roots. Unit: neighbors.

fields.name: degreeRank
fields.description: Rank by degree, 1 = highest, among 1,642 roots.

fields.name: weightedDegree
fields.description: Sum of incident edge weights (LLR).

fields.name: weightedDegreeRank
fields.description: Rank by weighted degree.

fields.name: betweenness
fields.description: Betweenness centrality (unweighted shortest paths).

fields.name: betweennessRank
fields.description: Rank by betweenness.

fields.name: eigenvector
fields.description: Eigenvector centrality (LLR-weighted, power iteration, L2-normalized).

fields.name: eigenvectorRank
fields.description: Rank by eigenvector centrality.

resources.name: discursive-pivots
resources.title: Divine Discourses: discursive-pivots
resources.description: 137 verses mechanically flagged for opening with a temporal particle (idh or idha) while sharing a content root with the immediately preceding verse.

fields.name: surah
fields.description: Surah number.

fields.name: verse
fields.description: The flagged verse.

fields.name: marker
fields.description: The temporal particle opening the verse: idh or idha.

fields.name: previousVerse
fields.description: The preceding verse the flagged verse shares a root with.

fields.name: sharedRoots
fields.description: Semicolon-separated list of the shared root(s) in Latin transliteration.

resources.name: dispersion
resources.title: Divine Discourses: dispersion
resources.description: How evenly each of the 1,642 roots is spread across the 114 surahs, weighted by surah token count.

fields.name: root
fields.description: Buckwalter-transliterated root.

fields.name: safeKey
fields.description: URL/filename-safe encoding of root.

fields.name: rootLatin
fields.description: Root in Latin transliteration with diacritics.

fields.name: totalCount
fields.description: Corpus-wide occurrence count. Unit: occurrences.

fields.name: surahsOccurringIn
fields.description: Count of the 114 surahs the root occurs in at least once.

fields.name: dp
fields.description: Gries's Deviation of Proportions. Range [0, 1 - min part share).

fields.name: dpNorm
fields.description: DP rescaled to [0, 1] via the Lijffijt & Gries (2012) correction.

fields.name: juillandD
fields.description: Juilland's D; 1 = perfectly even. Not clamped, can be negative.

fields.name: adjustedFrequency
fields.description: totalCount * (1 - dp): raw frequency discounted for clumping.

resources.name: fawatih
resources.title: Divine Discourses: fawatih
resources.description: The 29 surahs opening with a sequence of isolated letters (fawatih / al-muqatta'at), and which combination.

fields.name: surah
fields.description: Surah number.

fields.name: verse
fields.description: Verse carrying the isolated letters (always 1).

fields.name: letters
fields.description: The isolated letters in Arabic script, as written.

resources.name: formulaic-density
resources.title: Divine Discourses: formulaic-density
resources.description: Per-surah mean share of words covered by a recurring 3-5-word phrase (Bannister's oral-formulaic density), tested against a length-matched null, for all 114 surahs.

fields.name: surah
fields.description: Surah number.

fields.name: verseCount
fields.description: Verses in this surah.

fields.name: meanDensityRoot
fields.description: Mean per-verse root-stream formulaic density, 0-1.

fields.name: pValueRoot
fields.description: One-sided permutation p-value, root stream.

fields.name: survivorRoot
fields.description: Survives the pooled BH-FDR correction at q<0.05, root stream.

fields.name: meanDensitySurface
fields.description: Mean per-verse surface-stream formulaic density, 0-1.

fields.name: pValueSurface
fields.description: One-sided permutation p-value, surface stream.

fields.name: survivorSurface
fields.description: Survives the pooled BH-FDR correction at q<0.05, surface stream.

resources.name: formulas
resources.title: Divine Discourses: formulas
resources.description: Every recurring 3-5 word sequence in the Qur'an (18,408 rows: 6,403 root-view + 12,005 surface-view), with its first occurrence.

fields.name: stream
fields.description: root or surface.

fields.name: n
fields.description: Sequence length, 3-5. Unit: words.

fields.name: display
fields.description: Root stream: dot-separated Latin transliteration. Surface stream: the Arabic phrase itself.

fields.name: arabic
fields.description: Arabic script for the sequence (root stream: root letters; surface stream: same as display).

fields.name: count
fields.description: Total occurrences of this sequence across the corpus. Unit: occurrences.

fields.name: firstSurah
fields.description: Surah of the sequence's first occurrence.

fields.name: firstVerse
fields.description: Verse of the sequence's first occurrence.

resources.name: rhyme-summary
resources.title: Divine Discourses: rhyme-summary
resources.description: Per-surah roll-up of verse-ending (rhyme) patterns for all 114 surahs.

fields.name: surah
fields.description: Surah number, 1-114.

fields.name: verseCount
fields.description: Number of verses in the surah. Unit: verses.

fields.name: familyCount
fields.description: Count of distinct fine-key rhyme families in the surah.

fields.name: dominantKey
fields.description: The most frequent fine rhyme key in the surah.

fields.name: dominantShare
fields.description: Share of verses ending on the dominant key, 0-1.

fields.name: shiftCount
fields.description: Number of verse-to-verse changes in the fine rhyme key.

fields.name: topRefrainPausal
fields.description: Pausal form of the most-repeated verse ending recurring 3+ times, if any; null otherwise.

fields.name: topRefrainCount
fields.description: Occurrences of topRefrainPausal; null if there is no refrain.

fields.name: meanRunLength
fields.description: verseCount / (shiftCount + 1): average consecutive-verse run on one ending before it changes. Unit: verses.

resources.name: root-frequencies
resources.title: Divine Discourses: root-frequencies
resources.description: Every one of the 1,642 roots: raw occurrence count, overall normalized frequency, and per-period count and normalized frequency.

fields.name: root
fields.description: Buckwalter-transliterated root.

fields.name: safeKey
fields.description: URL/filename-safe encoding of root, used to link to data/association/{safeKey}.json and roots.html?root={safeKey}.

fields.name: arabic
fields.description: Root letters in Arabic script, space-separated.

fields.name: rootLatin
fields.description: Root in Latin transliteration with diacritics.

fields.name: totalCount
fields.description: Total occurrences of this root across the whole corpus (77,429 tokens). Unit: tokens.

fields.name: normalizedFrequencyOverall
fields.description: (totalCount / 77,429) * 1000. Unit: occurrences per 1,000 tokens.

fields.name: count_meccan-early
fields.description: Occurrences of this root in the Early Meccan period. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: normalizedFrequency_meccan-early
fields.description: (count_meccan-early / period token total) * 1000. Unit: occurrences per 1,000 tokens.

fields.name: count_meccan-middle
fields.description: Occurrences of this root in the Middle Meccan period. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: normalizedFrequency_meccan-middle
fields.description: (count_meccan-middle / period token total) * 1000. Unit: occurrences per 1,000 tokens.

fields.name: count_meccan-late
fields.description: Occurrences of this root in the Late Meccan period. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: normalizedFrequency_meccan-late
fields.description: (count_meccan-late / period token total) * 1000. Unit: occurrences per 1,000 tokens.

fields.name: count_medinan
fields.description: Occurrences of this root in the Medinan period. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: normalizedFrequency_medinan
fields.description: (count_medinan / period token total) * 1000. Unit: occurrences per 1,000 tokens.

resources.name: structure
resources.title: Divine Discourses: structure
resources.description: Mechanically segmented sections for all 114 surahs (TextTiling-derived changepoint detection over lexical cohesion), not a transcribed scholarly outline.

fields.name: surah
fields.description: Surah number.

fields.name: sectionIndex
fields.description: 1-based section number within the surah.

fields.name: fromVerse
fields.description: First verse of the section.

fields.name: toVerse
fields.description: Last verse of the section.

fields.name: verseCount
fields.description: Number of verses in the section. Unit: verses.

resources.name: structure-tests
resources.title: Divine Discourses: structure-tests
resources.description: Four block-level mirror-symmetry tests (concentric pairing, inclusio, formula bookending, verse-length symmetry) over the computed sections in the structure table, one row per surah.

fields.name: surah
fields.description: Surah number.

fields.name: verseCount
fields.description: Verses in the surah. Unit: verses.

fields.name: sections
fields.description: Number of computed sections (from the structure table).

fields.name: concentricParallelism_observed
fields.description: Observed mean Jaccard similarity of mirrored section pairs; null if the surah has too few sections for this test.

fields.name: concentricParallelism_pValue
fields.description: Permutation p-value for concentricParallelism; null if not applicable.

fields.name: concentricParallelism_survivor
fields.description: Whether this candidate survived the pooled Benjamini-Hochberg correction; null if not applicable.

fields.name: inclusio_observed
fields.description: Observed vocabulary overlap between the first and last section; null if not applicable.

fields.name: inclusio_pValue
fields.description: Permutation p-value for inclusio; null if not applicable.

fields.name: inclusio_survivor
fields.description: Whether this candidate survived correction; null if not applicable.

fields.name: formulaBookending_observed
fields.description: Observed formula-bracketing statistic; null if not applicable.

fields.name: formulaBookending_pValue
fields.description: Permutation p-value for formulaBookending; null if not applicable.

fields.name: formulaBookending_survivor
fields.description: Whether this candidate survived correction; null if not applicable.

fields.name: lengthSymmetry_observed
fields.description: Observed correlation of the verse-length profile with its reverse; null if not applicable.

fields.name: lengthSymmetry_pValue
fields.description: Permutation p-value for lengthSymmetry; null if not applicable.

fields.name: lengthSymmetry_survivor
fields.description: Whether this candidate survived correction; null if not applicable.

fields.name: surah
fields.description: Surah number, 1-114, Cairo (mushaf) order.

fields.name: nameTranslit
fields.description: Transliterated surah name.

fields.name: nameArabic
fields.description: Surah name in Arabic script.

fields.name: nameEnglish
fields.description: English meaning of the surah name.

fields.name: revelationOrder
fields.description: Position in the Cairo 1924 revelation-order sequence (1 = first revealed).

fields.name: period
fields.description: One of meccan-early, meccan-middle, meccan-late, medinan (Nöldeke-Bell four-period classification).

fields.name: verseCount
fields.description: Number of verses (ayat) in the surah, Cairo numbering. Unit: verses.

fields.name: tokenCount
fields.description: Total Leeds morphological tokens in the surah. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: distinctRootCount
fields.description: Count of distinct roots attested in the surah. Unit: roots.

fields.name: rootDiversityRatio
fields.description: distinctRootCount / tokenCount.

fields.name: distinctFormCount
fields.description: Count of distinct surface (written) forms in the surah. Unit: forms.

fields.name: formDiversityRatio
fields.description: distinctFormCount / tokenCount. Mechanically declines as tokenCount grows (a sample-size artifact); see formMATTR/formMTLD for length-robust alternatives.

fields.name: formMATTR
fields.description: Moving-average type-token ratio (Covington & McFall 2010) over the surah's ordered surface-form tokens, 25-token window. Null for the 9 surahs shorter than the window.

fields.name: formMTLD
fields.description: Measure of Textual Lexical Diversity (McCarthy & Jarvis 2010): mean tokens-per-factor at a 0.72 TTR threshold, bidirectionally averaged. Null only if the surah's running TTR never reaches the threshold. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: distinctLemmaCount
fields.description: Count of distinct lemmas in the surah. Unit: lemmas.

fields.name: lemmaDiversityRatio
fields.description: distinctLemmaCount / tokenCount.

fields.name: nounPct
fields.description: Percentage of the surah's tokens tagged noun (N) by Leeds POS tagging. Unit: percent.

fields.name: verbPct
fields.description: Percentage of the surah's tokens tagged verb (V) by Leeds POS tagging. Unit: percent.

resources.name: theme-surah-density
resources.title: Divine Discourses: theme-surah-density
resources.description: Sparse theme-by-surah matrix: for each surah, the themes whose root-family vocabulary clusters most densely in it.

fields.name: surah
fields.description: Surah number.

fields.name: themeSlug
fields.description: Theme identifier, matches themes.html's slug.

fields.name: themeTitle
fields.description: Theme display title.

fields.name: perThousand
fields.description: Density of this theme's root family in this surah. Unit: theme-root tokens per 1,000 surah tokens.

resources.name: verse-lengths
resources.title: Divine Discourses: verse-lengths
resources.description: Every verse in the corpus (6,236 rows) with its token length and revelation period.

fields.name: surah
fields.description: Surah number, 1-114.

fields.name: verse
fields.description: Verse (ayah) number within the surah, Cairo numbering.

fields.name: tokens
fields.description: Number of Leeds morphological tokens in this verse. Unit: tokens.

fields.name: period
fields.description: One of meccan-early, meccan-middle, meccan-late, medinan; null if the surah has no chronology entry.
